days.title: 까오다이 성좌 – 바덴산 정상
days.morning: Leave Saigon early (about 2.5 hours), have Trang Bang noodle soup for breakfast and reach the Cao Dai Holy See for the noon service.
days.afternoon: Take the cable car to the top of Ba Den Mountain for the Tay Bo Da Son statue and the sea of clouds.
days.evening: Young beef and dew-dried rice paper in Tay Ninh city.

days.title: 바 사원 – 바덴산 등산로
days.morning: Visit the main pagoda (Linh Son Tien Thach) halfway up the mountain and the cave pagoda.
days.afternoon: Hike part of the trail or ride the toboggan down.
days.evening: Browse Long Hoa market for shrimp salt and rice paper to take home.

days.title: 저우띠엥 호수
days.morning: Head to Dau Tieng Lake – one of the largest reservoirs in Vietnam.
days.afternoon: Stroll the shore, eat grilled fish and wait for sunset over the water.

days.title: 중앙국 기지 – 로고 사맛
days.morning: The historic Central Office for South Vietnam base deep in the Tan Bien forest.
days.afternoon: Lo Go – Xa Mat National Park: dry dipterocarp forest and birdwatching.
days.evening: Back to Tay Ninh for sizzling pancakes and fish hotpot.

days.title: 짱방 – 호찌민시로
days.morning: Trang Bang dew-dried rice paper village – watch it being made.
days.afternoon: Stop at the Cu Chi tunnels on the way back.
days.evening: Return to Ho Chi Minh City.
